description: Use when a parent is preparing young kids (about 2-10) for a ski trip: frostnip and frostbite on cheeks, fingers and toes; hypothermia signs; how cold is too cold (wind chill cutoffs); altitude at Colorado/Utah resorts. Lists SkiReady guides with quick answers and links, plus the resorts that have live NWS cold checks.
name: list_ski_cold_guides
title: SkiReady: cold-safety guides for families skiing with kids
